title: Arguments of `pc.delete_test_file` (one file of the test folder)
description: The `authz.object.args` of an approval card and of the approved `node.action` (§9.3, §9.4): the exact file object the person approves deleting. Also one entry of a folder listing.

name.description: A plain file name (§9.4): no separator, `..`, drive letter, stream (`:`) or device name.

file_id.description: Windows file ID: the 64-bit volume serial number and the 128-bit file ID from `GetFileInformationByHandleEx(FileIdInfo)`, lower-case hex, joined by `:`.
